{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sal-Solo mansion''' was a squarish [[Stone/Legends|stone]] building built to military standards located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was surrounded by a trench of [[Water/Legends|water]], and was only accessible through a narrow wooden bridge that crossed the trench. Surrounding the structure was a high stone wall made of the same stone, as well trees and ornamental bushes.

[[Tiion Sal-Solo]] and her son [[Thrackan Sal-Solo|Thrackan]] had once inhabited the mansion.
